pages.text: A $(thing)Bellows$() pushes air into the device it faces, or into one a block lower than that: a $(l:getting_started/firepit)Firepit$(), a $(l:metalworking/charcoal_forge)Charcoal Forge$(), a blast furnace. More air makes the fuel burn hotter and twice as fast, and gives off twice the gas.$(br2)The blast adds at most 500 °C to the fuel. A forge on charcoal tops out at 1600 °C, so melting steel is hard, as it should be.
Set the bellows facing the device and use it. Each push raises the highest temperature for a short while. A crankshaft can work it. On a mold table it cools the metal faster.
